title: Verify equivalent device layouts
outcome: Produce one public-API conformance fixture proving that equivalent contiguous and positive-strided device views preserve logical values, or record the precise missing-view blocker without claiming support.
accepted_decisions: Native default does not permit arbitrary fast math or silent precision loss.
Repeatability does not imply launch-geometry or cross-target invariance.
Use owned runners only; no commits, pushes or releases in this task.
Private implementation can be read for diagnosis but public acceptance examples cannot import it.
narrowing: This task covers contiguous versus positive-strided layout only; split tile/block changes into num-tiling-case to avoid testing two independent invariances at once.

baseline.note: Prepared example only; coordinator must freeze source including uncommitted changes and supply dependency receipts before dispatch.

allowed_files: tests/contracts/test_layout_invariance.py (new; proposed path reserved by coordinator)
tests_and_expected_results: Construct a contiguous 3x3 float32 matrix and a positive-strided view over a larger allocation with identical logical values.
Assert the actual object passed to the kernel retains shape(3,3), a nonzero base offset and strides different from the contiguous tensor; record observed launch descriptors.
Copy each logical element and compare output bits exactly; finite integer-valued row sums must equal [3,12,21] in the fixed ordered kernel.
Add an empty shape and a one-element view without reading padding.
Exercise one declared unsupported layout and verify the specific public error; a refusal proves only the refusal contract.
Repeat on locally admitted CPU/Metal and reserved owned CUDA as available; missing hardware stays unverified, not green.
Do not use np.allclose as evidence of repeatable/portable equality; compare bits only where that exact contract applies.
oracle_code:
# Runnable host oracle only; it does not exercise krn or establish device strides.
import numpy as np
contiguous = np.arange(9, dtype=np.float32).reshape(3, 3)
backing = np.full((3, 7), np.nan, dtype=np.float32)
backing[:, 1:6:2] = contiguous
strided = backing[:, 1:6:2]
assert strided.shape == contiguous.shape
assert strided.strides == (28, 8)
assert contiguous.strides == (12, 4)
assert strided.ctypes.data - backing.ctypes.data == 4
np.testing.assert_array_equal(strided, contiguous)
np.testing.assert_array_equal(contiguous.sum(axis=1), [3, 12, 21])
device_adapter_requirement: Construct the device view using the accepted public API and verify its real launch shape/strides/offset before executing; do not invent a proposed call in a supposedly runnable example.
known_trap: fresh() copies NumPy views, CUDA to_device densifies with np.ascontiguousarray, and Metal to_device copies into a fresh allocation. Those helpers must not be used to claim preserved device-layout coverage.

command_notes: Proposed focused commands only; --no-cov avoids presenting a narrow run as whole-library coverage, while cumulative milestone verification measures the declared coverage denominator.
exclusions: Do not implement device-view support or fix compiler stride lowering in this leaf.
Do not change global numerical defaults, arithmetic lowering, reduction trees, output allocation or private/public module layout.
Do not add negative/zero-stride support, aliasing writes or launch-geometry invariance.
Do not make cross-vendor bitwise claims from three hardware runs.
Do not edit another repository or obtain paid compute.

budget.suggested: One bounded verification slice; coordinator sets time budget and device reservation before dispatch.
budget.stop: Stop immediately if the public view contract/receipt is absent, actual launch strides are erased, or accepted arithmetic promises conflict. Two materially different failed attempts or exhausted task budget ends the failing work.

blocker_example.blocking_condition: No accepted public constructor preserves a positive-strided device view; existing upload helpers densify.
blocker_example.reproducer: Show contiguous and host-strided inputs yielding identical contiguous device strides; attach source lines and observed descriptor.
blocker_example.expected: A documented public strided view reaches the launch unchanged, or a deliberate unsupported-layout error occurs.
blocker_example.unblock: A separate tensor-view task supplies the accepted public view API and a receipt proving stride/base preservation.
blocker_example.independent_work: Finish the host oracle, case specification and read-only source audit; do not mark device conformance accepted.

source_refresh: Read official numerical reproducibility references already attached to num-layout-case and pin the relevant compiler/runtime versions.
Inspect the accepted view/API dependency revision before dispatch; no new paper search is needed merely to compare storage mapping.
Record changed source assumptions and exact documents read; no source excerpt alone is hardware evidence.
completion_receipt: Target and actual launch layout descriptors
review_focus: Reviewer verifies that the tested object is genuinely strided on the device, no helper normalized it, the oracle is independent, and no guarantee was silently weakened.
